EN: Cigarette! Whoo!
ZH: 香烟！喔！

EN: House on fire?
ZH: 房子着火？

EN: Soul afffflllaaammmee!! Yeah!
ZH: 灵魂燃——烧！！耶！

EN: Night. I think.
ZH: 晚上吧。我觉得。

EN: Day. Definitely day.
ZH: 白天。绝对是白天。

EN: I lost track. Does it really matter?
ZH: 我搞不清时间了。有关系吗？

EN: Yeah, she went that way.
ZH: 是的，她往那边走了。

EN: Hmm? Oh, yeah, I think he's down there.
ZH: 嗯？哦，有，我想他在下面那儿。

EN: But... But... I thought I was your best friend...
ZH: 可……可……我以为我才是你最好的朋友……

EN: Hmmm... Scorpion against bear... Gotta go bear.
ZH: 嗯……蝎子对熊……当然得选熊。

EN: You're kidding, right? Radscorpion. All the way.
ZH: 你在开玩笑吧？当然是辐射蝎。必须选它。

EN: Who cares? Super Mutant Behemoth vs. Deathclaw. Now that's a REAL fight.
ZH: 谁在乎呢？巨兽对战死爪。这才是真正的战斗。

EN: My death is on your conscience!
ZH: 如果我死了，看你对不对得起你的良心！

EN: After I conquer the Wasteland, I'm going to come back and conquer you!
ZH: 等我征服了废土，一定会回来征服你们！

EN: It's been real, it's been nice, but it hasn't been real nice.
ZH: 曾经很真实，曾经很美好，但不是真正的美好。

EN: So you're really doing it. Kicking me out. Not cool...
ZH: 所以你真的要这么做了。赶我走。不仗义……

EN: The Wasteland. Greeeeeaaaat.
Whatever. I outgrew this Vault a long time ago anyway.
ZH: 算了，这个避难所很早就已经容不下我了。

EN: You're going to miss me more than I miss you!
ZH: 你们想念我肯定比我想念你们多！

EN: So long, suckers!
ZH: 再见了，傻瓜们！

EN: I was planning on leaving anyway. So there.
ZH: 我本来就打算走的，现在正好。

EN: You're going to regret this. You'll see.
ZH: 你会后悔的。等着瞧。

EN: Was it something I said?
ZH: 是因为我说了什么吗？

EN: Wait. Wait wait wait. One sec, okay? There has to be a mistake!
ZH: 等等，等等等等。等一下，好吗？一定是哪里搞错了！

EN: Can't we talk about this?
ZH: 我们不能再谈谈吗？

EN: Banishment? Seriously?
ZH: 驱逐？真的吗？

EN: You'll rue the day you banished me! Rue the day!
ZH: 你会后悔你赶走了我！后悔！

EN: But I can still come visit, right? Right?
ZH: 但我还是能来拜访，对吗？对吗？

EN: This is ridiculous. Do you have any idea how important I am?!
ZH: 真是可笑。你知道我有多重要吗？！

EN: Wait ‘till the Overseer hears about this. Heads are going to roll!
ZH: 等监督者听说这事，有人要掉脑袋了！

EN: Worst. Day. EVER.
ZH: 最。糟糕的。一天。

EN: Freedom! Sweet, terrible freedom!
ZH: 自由！美好又可怕的自由！

EN: Later, ‘taters.
ZH: 回见啦，小土豆们。

EN: “A Better Future... Underground.” Yeah, right.
ZH: “一个更好的未来……就在地下。”是啊，才怪。

EN: Well, it was nice while it lasted.
ZH: 唉，好景不长啊。

EN: At least now I'll be able to own my own home.
ZH: 至少现在我可以拥有自己的家了。

EN: Overseer! Overseer, help! They're kicking me out!
ZH: 监督者！监督者，救命！他们想踹我出去！

EN: Pfffft. Whatever.
ZH: 切。无所谓。

EN: You guys are doing me a favor. I was getting too soft in the Vault.
ZH: 你们算是帮了我一个忙。我在避难所里好像住得过于舒服了。

EN: But I can still come back and visit. Right?
ZH: 但我还是能来拜访的。对吗？

EN: Let's get one thing straight - you're not evicting me! I'm leaving of my own free will!
ZH: 让我们把话说清楚——不是你驱逐我，而是我自己想走的！

EN: If there was a problem, you could have mentioned that BEFORE KICKING ME OUT!
ZH: 如果你对我有什么意见，应该在赶我走之前就告诉我！

EN: Oh no! Critical production failure!
ZH: 哦不！生产出了严重事故！

EN: Think I'll just relax for a bit.
ZH: 我觉得我应该休息下。

EN: Time for a shift yet?
ZH: 到换班时间了吗？

EN: Good to have some time to myself.
ZH: 能有点自己的时间，真好。

EN: If only I had the right kind of company...
ZH: 要是能有个对的人作伴就好了……

EN: It's not much... but it's home.
ZH: 虽然简陋……但这里是家。

EN: Things are running smoothly.
ZH: 一切运转顺畅。

EN: All systems nominal.
ZH: 所有系统运转正常。

EN: No problems. Just the way I like it.
ZH: 没问题。我就喜欢这样。

EN: We seem to be running at peak efficiency.
ZH: 我们似乎正以最高效率运行着。

EN: Production is maximized. Good.
ZH: 产能拉满。很好。

EN: Wonder what's for dinner?
ZH: 不知道晚餐吃什么呢？

EN: Yaaawwn
Maybe I should take a walk outside. What's the worst that could happen?
ZH: 也许我该出去走走。能有多可怕呢？

EN: The Vault is kind of like a house, I guess. A big, metal, subterranean house.
ZH: 要我说，避难所也就像座房子——一座大大的、金属的、埋在地底的房子。

EN: I'm kind of bored. I guess I should be thankful.
ZH: 我有点无聊。不过这么一想，也该知足了。

EN: Nothing like working up a sweat!
ZH: 没有什么能比运动得汗流浃背更爽了！

EN: Faster stronger better!
ZH: 更快、更强、更好！

EN: Time to get the blood pumping!
ZH: 让血液沸腾起来吧！

EN: Feel like I could take on the Commies bared handed!
ZH: 感觉自己能徒手单挑赤色分子！

EN: Cardio, weights, calisthenics I can do it all!
ZH: 有氧、举重、徒手操，我全都在行！

EN: Great time for a workout!
ZH: 正是锻炼的好时候！

EN: Just another great day in the Vault.
ZH: 又是避难所里美好的一天。

EN: Glad I'm in here and not out there...
ZH: 真高兴自己待在避难所里，而不是外头……

EN: Things are looking good.
ZH: 事情看起来不错。

EN: Maybe the Overseer will send me out exploring soon...
ZH: 说不定监督者很快就会派我出去探险了……

EN: I think we should throw a party. Everybody loves parties!
ZH: 我想我们应该办一个派对。所有人都爱派对！

EN: Did China build Vaults? Huh.
ZH: 中国也建过避难所吗？谁知道呢。

EN: I'd whistle a tune right now... if I knew how.
ZH: 真想现在就吹声口哨……要是我会的话。

EN: I wonder what day it is. Not that it matters.
ZH: 都不知道今天几号了，反正也不重要。

EN: I've got one goal in life - to make this Vault perfect!
ZH: 我人生只有一个目标——让这个避难所变得更完美！

EN: Could things get any better? Probably not.
ZH: 还可以更好点吗？大概不会了吧。

EN: Thinking of starting a Vault baseball team...
ZH: 想组建一支避难所棒球队……

EN: Anybody want to do a puzzle later?
ZH: 谁想待会儿做一个填字游戏？

EN: How's everybody doing?
ZH: 大家都过得怎么样？

EN: Everybody doing okay?
ZH: 大家都过得好吗？

EN: Hey gang!
ZH: 嘿，伙计们！

EN: How does that joke go again? A man and a rabbit walk into a bar...
ZH: 那个笑话是怎么说的来着？一个男人和一只兔子走进酒吧……

EN: I've got this song stuck in my head. La la, di di do do...
ZH: 这首歌一直在我脑子里循环。啦啦，滴滴咚咚……

EN: Oooh. I think I feel a bathroom break coming on.
ZH: 噢，我好像得去趟洗手间了。

EN: I feel like I've been on my feet forever...
ZH: 我感觉自己都站了好久了……

EN: Wonder if there's enough room to play football in the Vault...
ZH: 不知道避难所里有没有足够的地方玩橄榄球……

EN: Maybe I'll read a good book later. One of the classics.
ZH: 也许我待会可以读本好书。经典名著那种。

EN: Hmm... Maybe we should all paint the Vault a different color.
ZH: 嗯……也许咱们该一起给避难所刷个别的颜色。

EN: Huh. Thought I heard a humming in the ventilation system.
ZH: 咦，我好像听到通风系统里有嗡嗡声。

EN: Was that... skittering? Darned Radroaches could be right under us.
ZH: 刚才是……窸窸窣窣的动静？该死的辐射蟑螂可能就在我们脚下。

EN: Nothing like feeling safe and secure.
ZH: 没什么比满满的安全感更舒服的了。

EN: If we keep expanding, we may reach China!
ZH: 要是我们继续扩建，说不定能一路扩到中国去！

EN: I'm tired of Cram. We really need a taco night.
ZH: 我吃腻饱饱牌肉罐头了。我们真该搞个塔可之夜。

EN: I could really go with a nice, relaxing bath.
ZH: 我真的需要去好好洗个澡，放松一下。

EN: Brrr... There's a draft coming from somewhere.
ZH: 冷死了……哪儿来的穿堂风？

EN: I wonder what the future will bring...
ZH: 真不知道未来会是什么样……

EN: Why blue? I mean, would a yellow jumpsuit really be THAT bad?
ZH: 为什么是蓝色的？我想说，一件黄色的连身衣真的有那么糟糕吗？

EN: What's that smell? Is... EW. Plumbing must be backed up again.
ZH: 那是什么味儿？是……呕，管道肯定又堵了。

EN: I bet the Overseer is like Santa Claus. Fat, magical, and always watching.
ZH: 我敢打赌，监督者就像圣诞老人：胖胖的，有魔力，还无时无刻不在看着我们。

EN: I'm just full of vim and vigor!
ZH: 我这真是干劲十足、活力满满！

EN: Our Vault feels just like a robot's womb! If robots... had mothers...
ZH: 我们的避难所感觉就像机器人的子宫！如果机器人……有母亲的话……

EN: Someday, maybe my grandkids will live here!
ZH: 说不定哪天，我的孙辈也能住在这里！

EN: Can you milk a Brahmin? ‘Cause that would mean... ICE CREAM!
ZH: 你能给双头牛挤奶吗？那岂不是说……有冰淇淋可以吃了！

EN: Ahhh, my aching back. We really need a Vault masseuse.
ZH: 啊，我的背好痛。我们迫切需要一个避难所按摩师。

EN: Everybody doing okay? Of course we are!
ZH: 每个人都过得很好吗？当然好了！

EN: We working hard, or hardly working? He he he he.
ZH: 我们是在卖力干活，还是压根没在干活？嘿嘿嘿嘿。

EN: The lack of sun is getting to me. Time to up my vitamin D dosage.
ZH: 老晒不到太阳，我都有点受不了了。该把维生素D加加量了。

EN: I don't care if the oceans are irradiated. I'd kill for some fish and chips.
ZH: 我才不在乎海洋辐射不辐射呢。为了来份炸鱼薯条，让我干什么都行。

EN: Hey hey hey, what do you say?
ZH: 嘿，嘿，嘿，怎么样啊？

EN: Time for a coffee break yet?
ZH: 到喝咖啡的时间了吗？

EN: Nuka-Cola this, Nuka-Cola that. I want some root beer.
ZH: 张口核子可乐，闭口核子可乐。我想喝根汁汽水。

EN: I need to look into Vault-Tec's retirement plan...
ZH: 我得去了解一下避难所科技的退休计划……

EN: If more bombs fell, would we even know it? Probably not.
ZH: 如果更多的炸弹落下，我们会知道吗？大概不会吧。

EN: Come on, everyone! The Overseer's counting on us!
ZH: 大家加油！监督者正指望着我们呢！

EN: I'm so happy today! I love the Vault! And my anti-depressants!
ZH: 我今天超开心！我爱避难所！也爱我的抗抑郁药！

EN: I admit, I've never seen another Vault, but ours MUST be the best.
ZH: 我承认，我从来没有见过另一个避难所，但我们的一定是最好的。

EN: I heard there are Vaults all over the country. But that's crazy talk.
ZH: 我听说全国到处都是避难所。但这也太疯狂了吧。

EN: Is it true there are Vaults all across the world? Naaahhh.
ZH: 全世界到处都是避难所，这是真的吗？不——会——吧……

EN: I wonder how high the Vault numbers go...
ZH: 不知道避难所的编号最大能排到多少……

EN: I'm special, gosh darn it. And someday, the Overseer WILL notice me.
ZH: 我明明就很特别，真见鬼。总有一天，监督者一定会注意到我。

EN: Anybody need help with anything?
ZH: 有人需要帮忙的吗？

EN: I wonder how a Vault Suit would look with cowboy boots.
ZH: 我想知道避难所套装和牛仔靴搭配会是什么样子。

EN: One thing they never tell you – are you supposed to wear underwear under the jumpsuit or not?
ZH: 有一件事他们从未告诉你——连身衣里应该穿内裤吗？

EN: I don't care what everyone says. Getting my pilot's license is NOT a crazy pipe dream.
ZH: 随别人怎么说，考下飞行执照才不是什么痴人说梦。

EN: Wait, is this my free time or my work time? I can't keep track anymore.
ZH: 等等，这是我的休息时间还是工作时间？我已经乱套了。

EN: I wonder if anyone wants to go to the Living Quarters with me and... dance.
ZH: 不知道有没有人愿意和我一起去宿舍……跳跳舞？

EN: I love my life!
ZH: 我热爱我的生活！

EN: Looks like I turned my frown upside down permanently!
ZH: 看来我这愁脸是要永远翻成笑脸了！

EN: Life is great!
ZH: 生活真美好！

EN: Everything is just... perfect.
ZH: 一切都……很完美。

EN: Not a care in the world!
ZH: 无忧无虑，啥烦心事都没有！

EN: I feel a sense of... bliss.
ZH: 我有一种……至福的感觉。

EN: I'm so happy I could pinch myself.
ZH: 我太高兴了，高兴得需要掐自己看看是不是真的。

EN: Life just couldn't get any better.
ZH: 生活真是太完美了。

EN: My life is so awesome.
ZH: 我的生活棒呆了！

EN: I really hope everyone else is as happy as I am.
ZH: 我真心希望其他人都像我一样快乐。

EN: Could I get any happier? Nope.
ZH: 我还能更快乐吗？不能。

EN: Another wonderful day in the Vault!
ZH: 在避难所里又度过了精彩的一天！

EN: What a great day!
ZH: 多好的一天啊！

EN: If joy is a state of mind, then my state of mind is great!
ZH: 如果快乐是一种精神状态，那么我的精神状态超级棒！

EN: I'm just so happy I could burst! But don't worry... I won't.
ZH: 我高兴得都快炸开了！不过别担心……我不会真炸的。

EN: I feel so much better!
ZH: 我感觉好多了！

EN: Children are the future of this Vault.
ZH: 孩子是避难所的未来。

EN: My kid's a little angel.
ZH: 我的孩子是个小天使。

EN: I'm not saying I have the best kid in the Vault, but... I totally do.
ZH: 我不是说我们家孩子是全避难所最棒的，但是……他还真是。

EN: Reproducing isn't just fun. It's our responsibility.
ZH: 生儿育女不只是乐趣，更是我们的责任。

EN: Being a parent is such a big responsibility. Good thing I'm great at it!
ZH: 当家长是个重大的责任，好在我特别擅长！

EN: It's so comforting to know my child will grow up here in the Vault.
ZH: 知道我的孩子会在这样的避难所里长大，我感到特别欣慰。

EN: My child is so perfect, I feel sorry for every other parent in here.
ZH: 我的孩子太完美了，我都替这里其他的家长感到心疼。

EN: Could my child BE more wonderful?
ZH: 我的孩子简直不能更棒了！

EN: Where's that child of mine? Bringing joy to the whole Vault, I'm sure!
ZH: 我的孩子在哪里？我相信他（她）能给整个避难所带来快乐！

EN: One day my perfect kid will grow into a perfect adult!
ZH: 有一天我完美的孩子会长成一个完美的大人！

EN: I just love my kid so much...
ZH: 我实在是太爱我的孩子了……

EN: Someday, my awesome kid will be an awesome worker!
ZH: 有一天，我那了不起的孩子将是一个了不起的工人！

EN: Children are like chocolates! You can never have too many!
ZH: 孩子就像巧克力！永远都不嫌多！

EN: Having kids means keeping our Vault going... forever!
ZH: 有孩子，就意味着我们的避难所能一直运转下去……永远！

EN: Phew! I really needed that!
ZH: 松一口气！我真的很需要那个！

EN: Ugh. Not feeling that well...
ZH: 呃。感觉不太舒服……

EN: I really need a breath of fresh air. Oh wait.
ZH: 我真需要呼吸口新鲜空气。哦，等等。

EN: I could really use some rest.
ZH: 我真的需要休息。

EN: Hmm. Not feeling too great...
ZH: 嗯。感觉不太好……

EN: I think I'm coming down with something.
ZH: 我想我可能要生病了。

EN: I need to take better care of myself...
ZH: 我得好好照顾自己了……

EN: I need a sick day.
ZH: 我得请一天病假。

EN: I feel terrible.
ZH: 我觉得不舒服。

EN: Anybody got a Stimpak?
ZH: 谁有治疗针？

EN: I think I need to lie down... for an hour or three...
ZH: 我想我需要躺下了……躺个一小时，或者三小时……

EN: I feel awful.
ZH: 我感觉很糟糕。

EN: I'm dying! Somebody help me!
ZH: 我要死了！救救我！

EN: I need a Stimpak!
ZH: 我需要一个治疗针！

EN: I need a doctor! This is an emergency!
ZH: 有医生吗！情况紧急！

EN: Life... flashing before my eyes...
ZH: 我的一生……正在眼前闪过……

EN: I'm headed towards the light...
ZH: 我正走向那道白光……

EN: Goodbye, cruel world!
ZH: 再见，残酷的世界！

EN: I wish more kids lived here.
ZH: 我希望有更多的孩子住在这里。

EN: Anybody want to play checkers?
ZH: 有人想玩跳棋吗？

EN: If I snuck outside, would anyone notice?
ZH: 如果我偷跑出去，会有人注意到吗？

EN: I wonder what it's like out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 我想知道废土是什么样的。

EN: Who wants to play hopscotch?
ZH: 有人想玩跳房子吗？

EN: I could drink Nuka-Cola all day long.
ZH: 我可以一整天都喝核子可乐。

EN: Maybe someone can find me some baseball cards.
ZH: 也许有人能帮我找到一些棒球卡。
